# 91. Every animatable property path

Every field whose schema type is an animatable value (`Animatable_*`: a static value, or an object with `value`/`keys`/`track`/`sim`, drivers and `expr`, spec 1 §1.11), reachable from each top-level object. `[]` is a list element, `<id>` a map key, `<tag>` a variable-font axis. Paths under `layer` apply to the layer types that own the field (see `05-layers.md`); `layer.transform.*` may also be written directly on the layer (`layer.position`). Tween property names are relative to the target (`03-timeline-and-tweens.md`).
